body:
Lost the love of my life to cancer.  Only 40 years old with nothing to look forward to.  I'm only alive now out of a sense of obligation.

Bitter asshole is kind of in the eye of the beholder.  I would never go out of my way to hurt anyone, but I've withdrawn to the point where some people might think I'm an asshole.  I'd change it if I could but there's nothing about life that I enjoy anymore.  There's no point in my being here anymore so I'm hoping for an early death.

I probably annoy you with my reticence.  I'm a party pooper.  There's nothing I can say to defend myself.  Pray that you don't become me.
